name: Phone frame
description: Mobile phone outline with notch; screen content goes on top as other elements
svg: <rect x='{sw/2}' y='{sw/2}' width='{w-sw}' height='{h-sw}' rx='{radius}' {@paint}/>{#if notch}<rect x='{w*0.3}' y='{sw/2}' width='{w*0.4}' height='{max(8,h*0.035)}' rx='{max(4,h*0.0175)}' fill='{stroke}'/>{/if}

name: Browser window
description: Browser window with title bar and three dots
svg: <rect x='{sw/2}' y='{sw/2}' width='{w-sw}' height='{h-sw}' rx='{radius}' fill='{fill}' stroke='none'/><path d='M{sw/2},{bar} V{radius} Q{sw/2},{sw/2} {radius},{sw/2} H{w-radius} Q{w-sw/2},{sw/2} {w-sw/2},{radius} V{bar} Z' fill='{fill2}'/><path d='M0,{bar} H{w}' stroke='{stroke}' stroke-width='{sw}'/>{#repeat i 3}<circle cx='{bar*0.5+i*bar*0.45}' cy='{bar/2}' r='{bar*0.13}' fill='{pick(i,"#ff5f57","#febc2e","#28c840")}'/>{/repeat}<rect x='{sw/2}' y='{sw/2}' width='{w-sw}' height='{h-sw}' rx='{radius}' fill='none' stroke='{stroke}' stroke-width='{sw}'/>

name: Button
description: UI button with rounded corners and centred label

name: Input field
description: Form text input; its text is the value or placeholder, left aligned

name: Image placeholder
description: Grey box with a picture glyph in the middle
svg: <rect x='{sw/2}' y='{sw/2}' width='{w-sw}' height='{h-sw}' rx='{radius}' {@paint}/><g transform='translate({w/2-min(w,h)*glyph/2},{h/2-min(w,h)*glyph/2}) scale({min(w,h)*glyph/24})' fill='none' stroke='{fill2}' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'><rect x='2' y='3' width='20' height='18' rx='2'/><circle cx='8' cy='9' r='2'/><path d='M22 17l-6-6L4 21'/></g>

name: Text lines
description: Placeholder text: n horizontal rounded bars; last bar shorter
svg: {#repeat i n}<rect x='{align=="left"?0:(i==n-1?w*(1-last)/2:0)}' y='{n==1?(h-thickness)/2:i*(h-thickness)/(n-1)}' width='{i==n-1&&n>1?w*last:w}' height='{thickness}' rx='{thickness/2}' fill='{fill}'/>{/repeat}

name: Progress dots
description: Row of n dots; the active one uses fill, the rest fill2
svg: {#repeat i n}<circle cx='{w/n*(i+0.5)}' cy='{h/2}' r='{min(h/2,w/n/3)}' fill='{i==active?fill:fill2}'/>{/repeat}

name: Scribble line
description: Hand-written looking wavy line used as placeholder text

name: Cursor with name
description: Collaborator name pill with a pointer arrow off its top-right corner (fill2 = pill fill, stroke = outline). side=right|left chooses where the arrow sits.
svg: <rect x='{sw/2}' y='{sw/2}' width='{w-sw}' height='{h-sw}' rx='{h/2-sw/2}' fill='{fill2}' stroke='{stroke}' stroke-width='{sw}'/><g transform='translate({side=="right"?w+arrow*0.15:-arrow*0.15},{-arrow*0.15}) scale({side=="right"?1:-1},1)'><path d='M{arrow*0.95},{-arrow*0.95} L{0},{-arrow*0.35} L{arrow*0.4},{-arrow*0.4} L{arrow*0.35},{0} Z' fill='{fill}' stroke='{stroke}' stroke-width='{sw}' stroke-linejoin='round'/></g>

name: Comment badge
description: Small rounded comment bubble with two lines and a tail at bottom-left
svg: <path d='M{radius},{sw/2} H{w-radius} Q{w-sw/2},{sw/2} {w-sw/2},{radius} V{h*0.78-radius} Q{w-sw/2},{h*0.78} {w-radius},{h*0.78} H{w*0.45} L{w*0.28},{h-sw/2} L{w*0.3},{h*0.78} H{radius} Q{sw/2},{h*0.78} {sw/2},{h*0.78-radius} V{radius} Q{sw/2},{sw/2} {radius},{sw/2} Z' {@paint}/><path d='M{w*0.25},{h*0.3} H{w*0.75} M{w*0.25},{h*0.5} H{w*0.75}' stroke='{stroke}' stroke-width='{sw}' stroke-linecap='round'/>
